pressure_definition.early_collapse: 5+ wickets lost by the end of the first 50% of allocated innings; flag starts on the next delivery
pressure_definition.death_phase: final 25% of allocated innings, rounded to full overs (overs 16-20 for 20 overs)

revised_allocation_encoding_check.interpretation_note: Revised fields are interpreted as ball allowances because all non-null supplied values are multiples of six. The source schema does not explicitly document units; inherited second-innings allocations are separately labelled.
